anomalies.description: A red sedan collides with a parked blue truck on the right shoulder, causing visible damage and dust/debris; the red car then veers left across the lane.; The red sedan, after the initial collision, crosses into the opposing lane and collides with a silver Audi A4 traveling in the opposite direction.
A blue sedan loses control on the icy road, slides sideways across the intersection, and collides with a pole or barrier near the sidewalk, causing visible impact and debris.
A blue car slides sideways on a snowy road, losing control and colliding with a street pole or barrier near the sidewalk; snow is displaced upon impact.

A red Mercedes sedan (license plate C334 BM-4) appears to be involved in a low-speed rear-end or side collision with a white SUV parked or stopped ahead; visible dust/smoke and slight vehicle displacement suggest impact.
A silver sedan collides with the rear of a red Mercedes sedan while both are moving; the impact causes the red car to lurch forward and the silver car to veer sharply left.
